title: Dihydromyricetin ameliorates diabetic renal fibrosis via regulating SphK1 to suppress the activation of NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Wen, Min; Sun, Xiaohong; Pan, Linjie; Jing, Shujin; Zhang, Xuting; Liang, Liyin; Xiao, Haiming; Liu, Peiqing; Xu, Zhanchi; Zhang, Qun; Huang, Heqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物DHM通过抑制SphK1活性进而阻断NF-kappaB通路改善糖尿病肾纤维化，虽涉及NF-kappaB DNA结合与分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合机制，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Dihydromyricetin (DHM) is a flavonoid from vine tea with broad pharmacological benefits, which improve inflammation by blocking the NF-kappaB pathway. A growing body of research indicates that chronic kidney inflammation is vital to the pathogenesis of diabetic renal fibrosis. Sphingosine kinase-1 (SphK1) is a key regulator of diabetic renal inflammation, which triggers the NF-kappaB pathway. Hence, we evaluated whether DHM regulates diabetic renal inflammatory fibrosis by acting on SphK1. Here, we demonstrated that DHM effectively suppressed the synthesis of fibrotic and inflammatory adhesion factors like ICAM-1, and VCAM-1 in streptozotocin-treated high-fat diet-induced diabetic mice and HG-induced glomerular mesangial cells (GMCs). Moreover, DHM significantly suppressed NF-kappaB pathway activation and reduced SphK1 activity and protein expression under diabetic conditions. Mechanistically, the results of molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and cellular thermal shift assay revealed that DHM stably bound to the binding pocket of SphK1, thereby reducing sphingosine-1-phosphate content and SphK1 enzymatic activity, which ultimately inhibited NF-kappaB DNA binding, transcriptional activity, and nuclear translocation. In conclusion, our data suggested that DHM inhibited SphK1 phosphorylation to prevent NF-kappaB activation thus ameliorating diabetic renal fibrosis. This supported the clinical use and further drug development of DHM as a potential candidate for treating diabetic renal fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 二氢杨梅素（DHM）是一种来自藤茶的黄酮类化合物，具有广泛的药理益处，通过阻断NF-kappaB通路改善炎症。越来越多的研究表明，慢性肾脏炎症对糖尿病肾纤维化的发病机制至关重要。鞘氨醇激酶-1（SphK1）是糖尿病肾脏炎症的关键调节因子，可触发NF-kappaB通路。因此，我们评估了DHM是否通过作用于SphK1来调节糖尿病肾炎症性纤维化。在此，我们证明DHM有效抑制了链脲佐菌素处理的高脂饮食诱导的糖尿病小鼠及高糖诱导的肾小球系膜细胞（GMCs）中纤维化和炎症粘附因子（如ICAM-1和VCAM-1）的合成。此外，DHM在糖尿病条件下显著抑制了NF-kappaB通路的激活，并降低了SphK1活性和蛋白表达。机制上，分子对接、分子动力学模拟和细胞热位移实验结果表明，DHM稳定结合于SphK1的结合口袋，从而降低鞘氨醇-1-磷酸含量和SphK1酶活性，最终抑制NF-kappaB DNA结合、转录活性和核转位。总之，我们的数据表明，DHM抑制SphK1磷酸化以防止NF-kappaB激活，从而改善糖尿病肾纤维化。这支持了DHM作为治疗糖尿病肾纤维化潜在候选药物的临床应用和进一步药物开发。
